'''Premiere - Cloud City (Modified)''' is a constructed format on [[GEMP]] (code <code>premiere_cc_m</code>). Its card pool is the same as [[Premiere - Cloud City]], Decipher set ids 1&ndash;5 and premium ids 101&ndash;105, with a ban list.<ref name="gemp" />

== Deck size ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Default deck size on [[GEMP]]
| 60 cards
|}
The GEMP format definition sets no deck size, so GEMP uses its default of 60 cards.<ref name="gemp-ec48dc19" /><ref name="lib-ec48dc19" />

== Ban list ==
GEMP bans these cards:<ref name="gemp" />
* Light Side: ''Never Tell Me The Odds'', ''Asteroid Sanctuary'', ''Anger, Fear, Aggression'', ''Clouds''
* Dark Side: ''3,720 To 1'', ''A Dangerous Time'', ''Defensive Fire'', ''Clouds'', ''Scanning Crew''
The 2024 Retro League used the first seven.<ref name="t84002" /> ''Clouds'' (Dark) and ''Scanning Crew'' were added for 2025,<ref name="t85234" /> and the list was unchanged in 2026.<ref name="t86593" />
